text:
zara_sales: Starting an RFI thread for Aperture Labs. They requested a 3-week POC (private VPC peering + CloudHSM or on-prem HSM), a capability matrix, and tiered pricing for embeddings (high QPS) + low-latency streaming. They also attached a security questionnaire and asked for a sample SOW and KMS flow.

mike_se: I can take the capability matrix + answers. Quick clarification: embeddings target is 120 QPS sustained with 99th pct latency < 300ms for single-vector retrievals. Do we recommend Dedicated Reserved or full Dedicated fleet for that?

eli_infra: For 120 QPS sustained, recommended starting config: Dedicated Reserved with 8xA10s using KV caching and dynamic batching; if they want headroom for spikes use A100 nodes (2xA100) and autoscale. On-prem HSM: supported (Thales, Entrust) but lead time 3-5 weeks. CloudHSM immediate. We can provide SOC2 and ISO certs under NDA; FedRAMP is a status statement only.

mike_se: Thanks. I'll draft a compact capability matrix snippet for the RFI (I'll also push a spreadsheet):

```
Requirement                  | Redwood Response                   | Notes
--------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------
Private VPC peering         | Supported                           | Customer-managed peering + IAM
HSM/KMS                     | CloudHSM, Thales, Entrust          | On-prem support with lead time
Embeddings throughput       | 120 QPS achievable                  | 8xA10 w/ batching + KV cache
99th pct embed latency       | <300ms (single-vector)              | Depends on payload size
Streaming (token) latency    | Low-latency streaming supported     | Chunked/resumable, SLA options
SAML/SCIM                   | Supported                           | SCIM group->role mapping available
Audit logs & retention      | Configurable (30/90/365)            | Extended retention as paid add-on
Data residency              | Regional/private deployment options | EU, US, APAC regions
Attestations                | SOC2, ISO27001 (NDA)                | FedRAMP: planning note
IAM examples                | Sample cross-account policy ready   | Will attach template
```

mike_se: I'll flag open items: exact 99th pct latency SLA wording, egress locking to gov-cloud endpoints, and whether they require encrypted snapshots.

zara_sales: Legal explicitly asked for: (1) HSM vendor attestation + KMS flow diagram, (2) sample NDA before certs, (3) example billing transition from POC to production, and (4) whether we offer SLA credits for embed latency breaches.

rachel_prod: For pricing: propose POC 3-week reserved at 35% off list for first month with 8 hours/week embedded SE support, then production tiers by monthly embed volume (0-10M / 10-50M / 50M+). Streaming charged per-token with low-latency surcharge for SLA. Include optional paid compliance add-on (365-day logs, monthly compliance reviews). I'll draft SOW with milestones.

eli_infra: Attestation notes: SOC2 Report ID SOC2-2024-RED-021 (available under NDA), ISO27001 Cert# ISO-RED-1167. We can provide HSM integration guide and a KMS flow diagram. Confirm we never store plaintext customer keys; keys are referenced by tokenized handles and operations delegated to HSM. Uploading KMS flow now.

ops-bot: File uploaded by eli_infra: aperture_kms_flow_v1.png -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/5012345678/aperture_kms_flow_v1.png

mike_se: I'll prepare a short perf note for embeddings: baseline microbench (8xA10) shows ~125 QPS sustained with 95th pct latency ~220ms, 99th ~320ms depending on payload. Recommend KV prefix caching for repeated prefixes. Will attach bench log.

ops-bot: File uploaded by mike_se: aperture_embed_bench_v1.txt -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/5012345678/aperture_embed_bench_v1.txt

zara_sales: Legal asks: can we include sample SLA credit language for 99th pct latency breaches? If so, draft will need legal review. Also they requested sample IAM policy for peering and a minimal SCIM mapping example.

rachel_prod: I'll include SLA credit draft: partial credit for 99th pct latency > 300ms, escalates to full credit for repeated misses over a month. Also SOW milestones: week 0 connectivity and keys, week 1 baseline bench, week 2 optimization (batching/quant), week 3 acceptance and handoff. Acceptance tests: embedding recall >= 0.7 on provided set + 95th pct latency < 250ms for streaming.

mike_se: SCIM note: we support SCIM 2.0 and can map groups to roles via attributes: group.displayName -> appRole. I'll attach a sample mapping snippet.

ops-bot: File uploaded by mike_se: aperture_scim_mapping.json -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/5012345678/aperture_scim_mapping.json

eli_infra: HSM vendor attestation placeholder uploaded: aperture_hsm_attest.txt -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/5012345678/aperture_hsm_attest.txt. Note: on-prem HSM installs require scheduling with field team; include contact for lead time.

zara_sales: Action list: (1) @mike_se finalize capmatrix + bench notes and attach spreadsheet, (2) @eli_infra upload formal cert IDs + HSM attestation under NDA, (3) @rachel_prod finalize pricing + SOW and sample SLA credit language, (4) Legal to review NDA before we share cert artifacts. Target: internal review tomorrow 10am then send to Aperture.

legal-bot: Legal: share NDA template first and mark cert/artifacts as "NDA only". We'll review SLA credit wording once submitted.

zara_sales: Thanks team. If Aperture pushes FedRAMP evidence we'll escalate to GRC. I'll bundle attachments and loop back once NDA is in place. End of thread.
